entities.summary: Dumitru Cipere is a retired bantamweight boxer from Romania who won bronze medals at the 1980 Olympics and 1981 European Championships. Cipere also won three national senior titles. He took up boxing aged 12 at CSM Severin and after retiring from competitions he worked as a coach there.
